story.title: Fi Money Shuts Consumer Banking, Pivots to AI and Enterprise Tech After Co-Founder Gwalani Exits
story.summary: Fi Money co-founder Sumit Gwalani has stepped down after six years, following the March 2026 shutdown of the neobank's consumer banking service and a broader strategic pivot toward AI and enterprise technology. The departure underscores the mounting pressures facing India's neobanking sector, where regulatory constraints on banking partnerships have made pure-play consumer neobanking increasingly difficult to sustain. The company's shift toward enterprise AI signals a growing trend of Indian fintech startups repositioning away from consumer finance toward B2B AI services.
